docs.description: The text copied to the clipboard.
Accessible label of the button. A new label re-renders the button and closes an open panel.
Shown and announced when copying failed and the page cancelled sb-copy-error (otherwise the panel opens).
The panel's message, and the name of its text field, when the browser can't copy: {key} becomes ⌘C on Apple systems, else Ctrl+C.
How long the copied or failed state lasts, in ms (at least 300).

events.name: sb-copy
events.description: After copying. detail: { value, method }: "clipboard" (the Clipboard API), "execCommand" (a hidden textarea, e.g. on plain http://) or "manual" (the user copied the whole text from the panel).

events.name: sb-copy-error
events.description: Cancelable. Neither the Clipboard API nor the hidden textarea could copy. detail: { value, error } (the Clipboard API's error name: "NotAllowedError" when refused, "TypeError" where there is none, e.g. on plain http://). Not cancelled, a panel selects the text for the user to copy; preventDefault() shows the cross and failed-label instead.
